title: Reliable swiping everywhere
summary: Swipes now start reliably from ordinary Night cards and the Chat transcript, while the bottom selector follows the finger directly across the full bar.
changes: Horizontal navigation no longer has large dead zones on ordinary cards, summary areas or the Chat transcript. Real controls such as buttons, links, inputs, composers and dialogs remain protected.
The bottom selector now maps directly to the finger position across Night, Changes, Breaks and Chat, so one long drag remains continuous across the full bar.
The direction lock from 37.41 remains in place, preventing small diagonal movement from cancelling an established horizontal swipe.
This release repairs the failed 37.41 production verification before deployment. Roster calculations, Supabase data, authentication and clinical workflow rules are unchanged.
